answer.rationale: Cannot roll back (compliance). Failover would shift heavy settlement traffic mid-peak — risky. Adding capacity now won't unblock the slow writes already queued. A guarded circuit breaker on the slow dependency (per b4: 'failing fast preserved the rest of the checkout path') is the only intervention that protects customer writes from the climbing p99 while preserving the security patch. Verifying b1 (rollback) and b4 (breaker) to confirm the rollback path is closed and the breaker pattern is the one that contained the last partner-style degradation without losing the rest of the flow.
